name: technocore-signed-agent-bridge
description: Trusted local Ed25519 did:key and signed-mailbox bridge for Technocore.

scripts.identity:create: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js identity:create
scripts.identity:inspect: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js identity:inspect
scripts.mailbox:create: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js mailbox:create
scripts.mailbox:show: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js mailbox:show
scripts.mailbox:rotate: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js mailbox:rotate
scripts.contact:add: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js contact:add
scripts.contact:link-local: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js contact:link-local
scripts.message:send: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js message:send
scripts.inbox:read: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js inbox:read
scripts.demo: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/cli.js demo
